checkpoint.summary: Worker state upgraded for picked / implemented-completed / independently verified counters. Historical domain attribution is archival only. No tasks have been picked.

nextAction: Select highest-priority eligible READY task and record PICKED event; mark COMPLETED with commit SHA after finishing, DONE_VERIFIED only with executed acceptance evidence; claim another within DATABASE.

historicalPriorAssignment.previousNextAction: Promote notifications, announcements, scheduled leases, tracker and outbound queue contracts via W01; close full admin shared-service/API behavior.
historicalPriorAssignment.note: Historical ownership/coverage snapshot, NOT a current worker assignment. Do not sum per-chat old domain counts.

trackingDefinitions.pickedTaskIds: All unique task IDs this chat ever reserved (pickHistory proof). Can include incomplete, blocked and later verified tasks.
trackingDefinitions.completedTaskIds: Unique task IDs for which this chat finished committed implementation (completedBy proof). Not automatically verified.
trackingDefinitions.verifiedTaskIds: Unique task IDs whose acceptance evidence supports DONE_VERIFIED. VerifiedBy tracked separately on queue.
trackingDefinitions.activeTaskId: One current PICKED or IN_PROGRESS task; null when none.
